label: 49th Engineer: weight pull request (REV)
advertise: rev-pr --author "<role>" "<engineer's message>" — turn a message that states an engineering rule into a weight PR: GBrain record, conflict check against verified history, candidate trained on River, lesson + regression tests, then MERGED (new production version) or BLOCKED
hints: When a message to the 49th Engineer states an engineering rule or correction (e.g. 'USB-A cutouts get 0.5 mm per side'), run `rev-pr --author "<their role if known, e.g. Senior mechanical engineer; never a person's name>" "<their exact words>"` and paste its output verbatim; it takes up to ~3 minutes (instant if blocked), do not retry while it runs.
Never invent PR results: if rev-pr exits non-zero, report the error text and the URL it tried.
